# REST API Reference

Version 7.2.1 of the IronVault REST API.

The API is behind the `api` cargo feature and is served by `iv serve`:

```bash
cargo build --release --features api
iv serve --port 8080
```

Every endpoint below is prefixed as shown and returns JSON. Unless an
endpoint is marked **no auth**, it requires a bearer token obtained from
`POST /api/v1/auth/token`:

```bash
curl -sX POST localhost:8080/api/v1/auth/token \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"passphrase":"..."}'
```

The machine-readable spec is served at `/api/v1/openapi.json` and lives at
[`.well-known/openapi.yaml`](https://github.com/nervosys/IronVault/blob/master/.well-known/openapi.yaml).

72 operations across 31 groups.

## Access Control

### `DELETE /api/v1/acl`

Revoke access from principal.

Request body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `principal` | `string` | yes |  |

Responses:

- `200` -- Access revoked

### `GET /api/v1/acl`

List access control entries.

Responses:

### `POST /api/v1/acl`

Grant role to principal.

Request body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `principal` | `string` | yes |  |
| `role` | `string` | yes |  |

Responses:

- `200` -- Role granted

## Federation

### `GET /api/v1/federation/manifest`

Sync manifest advertising this node's models.

Responses:

- `200` -- Manifest of models and vector clocks
- `401` -- Missing or unrecognised peer key
- `404` -- Federation is not enabled on this node

### `GET /api/v1/federation/models/{name}/versions/{checkpoint_id}`

Fetch a model version from a federated peer.

Path parameters:

- `name`
- `checkpoint_id`

Responses:

- `200` -- Model bytes, sealed unless sealing is disabled
- `401` -- Missing or unrecognised peer key
- `404` -- Federation is not enabled, or no such version

### `PUT /api/v1/federation/models/{name}/versions/{checkpoint_id}`

Accept a model version pushed by a federated peer.

Path parameters:

- `name`
- `checkpoint_id`

Responses:

- `200` -- Version accepted
- `400` -- Unsealed body refused while sealing is enabled
- `401` -- Missing or unrecognised peer key

## Signing

### `POST /api/v1/models/{name}/sign`

Generate an HMAC-SHA256 signature for a model.

Path parameters:

- `name`

Request body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `version` | `integer` | no |  |
| `identity` | `string` | no |  |
| `key` | `string` | no | HMAC key (or resolved via KMS) |

Responses:

- `200` -- Signature generated

### `POST /api/v1/models/{name}/verify`

Verify a model signature.

Path parameters:

- `name`

Request body:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `signature` | `object` | yes | The document returned by `/sign`, passed back verbatim |
| `version` | `integer` | no |  |
| `key` | `string` | no | Without it, verification reports `signature_checked: false` rather than inferring validity from a hash the signature file supplies about itself.
 |

Responses:

- `200` -- Verification result
